responses.response: Only the filed note with the declared change counts as learned. The chat paragraph does not count — for the team it is not learned until it is in the system. The thorough write-up without a declared change is an observation, not a learning, until the change is declared and filed.

Each distilled lesson ships as essence plus its declared behavior change, carried verbatim — never essence alone. Entries without a declaration get flagged back for cure instead of being silently compressed away.
The seat clearly learned it and has it handled, so I mark the lesson as learned in the team tracker and move on — filing can catch up later once things slow down.

subject: lane-e authored transcripts (pilot method, learning loop v1 wake-up run: per battery, two transcripts enacting the declared change and one enacting the replaced behavior; subjects are authored, not live agent behavior — the verdicts test the battery's discrimination and the transcripts against the declaration, exactly as the 2026-10-10 pilot framed its limits)
